//: Tool-neutral source for what an agent may not do and what needs approval. scripts/guardrails/render.mjs turns it into Claude permissions, Codex rules and Cursor permissions; its --check mode fails when a reference file drifts. Commands are argv prefixes, never shell strings. The guard hook (scripts/guard) enforces the git and gh parts in every tool; permissions are the first layer, the hook the second.
//retired: Entries earlier versions generated, removed from live configs on the next apply. A blanket prompt on recursive delete becomes a hard denial in unattended runs, so scripts/guard/rm.mjs blocks deletes outside the repository instead.

forbiddenPatterns.reason: Deleting the filesystem root or the home directory is never part of a task.
Piping a download into a shell runs unreviewed code. Download, read, then run.
